visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair in a ponytail stands in a bright shopping mall. She wears a grey plaid strapless dress and a black bolero cardigan. She adjusts the top edge of her dress with both hands while smiling down. Glass storefronts and reflective tile floors are visible. (2) The woman leans her arms on a wooden railing in a curved hallway. She looks directly at the camera with a joyful, wide smile. A 'Swatch' storefront with colorful watch displays is clearly visible in the background along with other retail signage. (3) The camera follows her as she walks and turns around, grinning over her shoulder. She raises her hands to adjust her hair, framing her face. The environment is a clean, modern commercial space with bright overhead lighting reflecting on the floor. (4) Back at the railing, she rests her chin on her hands, posing playfully. The camera pans slightly around her, capturing her from a side-view angle. A 'Breitling' store and escalators are seen in the distant background. (5) The woman peeks out from behind a large beige marble pillar, smiling brightly at the lens. She holds onto the edge of the pillar. The scene is well-lit with high-contrast cinematic lighting typical of high-end mall interiors.
